description: This file defines a Java interface named ClientDao, which specifies methods for accessing and manipulating Client objects in a database, including retrieving, saving, and removing clients.

classes.name: ClientDao
classes.description: Interface for Client data access object (DAO), declaring methods for CRUD operations on Client entities.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieves a Client object based on the provided clientId.

methods.name: saveClient
methods.description: Persists the given Client object to the database.

methods.name: removeClient
methods.description: Removes a Client from the database based on the provided clientId.
